regime_context: The detector shows a narrow eligible set (4 of 17 themes) with Banks (H + HK) as the only eligible theme in the top 5, leadership contested between Diversified Miners (rank 1, but not eligible) and Banks (rank 2, eligible). theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only eligible theme with a high momentum score (rank 2, score 1.185) AND a genuine durability leg (durability_bar 0.68, the highest in the top 5) plus strong breadth (0.769) — the cohesive leadership structure the absolute-trend gate is designed to hold through.
